biotools.summary: PbHiT is a CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing system for generating targeting vectors in the malaria parasite Plasmodium berghei. The online resource allows users to design knockout and tagging constructs, and corrects design errors that occurred between January 22, 2025 and June 11, 2025.
